name: print-social-bank-services-posts-black-orange-piggy-bank-line-art
title: Bank services Instagram pack with black cards, orange spotlight glow and line-art piggy bank icon
whatItIs: Nine black square posts with an orange radial spotlight glow, a recurring white line-art piggy bank with a hand dropping in a coin, bold white headlines ('Rely on us for reliable financial solutions.', 'Start Your Savings For The Future.') with orange highlighted words, and a blue 'Start Saving Online' pill.
whatItMeans: Trustworthy yet modern; the glowing spotlight on a simple line icon makes a bank feel approachable rather than corporate.
techniques: Repeat one line-art icon across an entire post set for brand recall.
Light the icon with a radial spotlight glow.
Highlight the key action word in the accent colour.

vocabulary.definition: A glow that fades outward from a central point.
An icon drawn with thin outline strokes only.
